findings.evidence: grep for `twoRank` in Basic.lean/Prod.lean shows no such lemma exists (only `twoRank_def`, `card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_two_pow_twoRank`, `twoRank_eq_of_mulEquiv`); the four diff sites are byte-for-byte the same argument modulo `pow_one`/`pow_zero`.
findings.fix: Add `theorem twoRank_eq_of_card_eq_two_pow [Module.Finite (ZMod 2) (ElementaryTwoQuotient G)] (h : Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) = 2 ^ n) : twoRank G = n` next to `card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_two_pow_twoRank` in Basic.lean, and make all four call sites one line.
findings.issue: The general fact `Nat.card (ElementaryTwoQuotient G) = 2 ^ n → twoRank G = n` is re-proved inline four times: Cyclic.lean:66-69 (`twoRank_of_isCyclic_of_even`), Cyclic.lean:72-75 (`twoRank_of_isCyclic_of_odd`), FreeModule.lean:80-84 (`twoRank_multiplicative`), UnitsElementaryTwoQuotient.lean `twoRank_units`. Each repeats `rw [card_elementaryTwoQuotient_eq_two_pow_twoRank, ← pow_k 2] at hcard; exact Nat.pow_right_injective le_rfl hcard`.

findings.evidence: Line 86 of TauCeti/NumberTheory/NumberField/UnitsElementaryTwoQuotient.lean; `h1.trans h2.symm : (ζ, toAdd e) = (ζ', toAdd e')` is a plain `Prod.mk` equation, for which `Prod.mk.inj`/`Prod.ext_iff` apply directly.
findings.fix: Use the named projection: `obtain ⟨hζ, he⟩ := Prod.mk.inj (h1.trans h2.symm)` (or `Prod.ext_iff.mp (h1.trans h2.symm)`).
findings.issue: `obtain ⟨hζ, he⟩ := Prod.mk.injEq .. ▸ h1.trans h2.symm` casts a proof along the auto-generated `injEq` equation of Props with fully elaborated `..` placeholders — a fragile motive-inference step whose purpose is not evident from the script.

findings.evidence: mathlib Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Prod.lean:464 `theorem coprod_apply (p : M × N) : f.coprod g p = f p.1 * g p.2 := rfl` — the lemma exists and is the intended interface.
findings.fix: Prove it as `by simp [torsionProdMultiplicativeToUnits, MonoidHom.coprod_apply]`, so a change to `coprod`'s internal construction cannot silently break it.
findings.issue: `torsionProdMultiplicativeToUnits_apply` is closed by bare `rfl`, relying on a chain of definitional unfoldings through `MonoidHom.coprod`, `Subgroup.subtype` and `MonoidHom.mk'` rather than the stated API. No comment records why the defeq is expected to hold.

summary: Proofs are short and mostly robust, but the same three-line "invert 2 ^ n" argument is copy-pasted in four places instead of being factored into a reusable lemma in Basic.lean, and the injectivity proof uses an obscure `▸` cast where a named projection exists.
